creature.name: Claw Of Choral

mid.name: Break Legs!
entries: The claw makes a maul Strike against an adjacent creature. If it hits, the creature is knocked prone and becomes clumsy 1 for 1 minute. As long as this clumsy condition lasts, the creature also takes a –5-foot penalty to its Speeds and has weakness 5 to the claw’s Strikes.

mid.name: Breath of the Dragon
entries: The claw breathes a blast of flame that deals 6d6 fire damage in a 20-foot cone (DC 21 basic Reflex save). The claw can’t use Breath of the Dragon again for 1d4 rounds.

mid.name: Stampeding Shove
entries: The claw Shoves a creature, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to their Athletics check if the target is prone. If the Shove succeeds, the target takes 2d10 bludgeoning damage (double damage on a critical success).

creature.name: Eye Of Choral

senses.name: darkvision , key sense,  scent  ( imprecise ) 60 feet, smoke vision

mid.name: Key Sense
entries: The Eye of Choral was created alongside several magical keys. It can sense the presence of these keys anywhere in Rahasia Rinca, communicate telepathically with anyone bearing a key within the complex, and always knows whether a creature possesses such a key.

mid.name: Shadow Construct
entries: The Eye of Choral is only semi-real. The first time each round a PC is hit by one of the Eye’s Strikes, the creature makes a DC 23 Will save to realize the creature’s attacks aren’t wholly real. The result applies to the damage of that Strike and lasts until the start of the creature’s next turn.

mid.name: Critical Success
entries: The creature gains resistance to damage from the Eye’s Strikes equal to its level.

mid.name: Success
entries: The creature gains resistance to damage from the Eye’s Strikes equal to half its level.

mid.name: Failure
entries: The creature is affected by the Eye’s Strikes as normal.

mid.name: Draconic Frenzy
entries: The Eye makes two claw Strikes and one wing Strike in any order.

mid.name: Draconic Momentum
entries: The Eye recharges their Pyre Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

mid.name: Pyre Breath
entries: The Eye breathes a blast of flame that deals 7d6 fire damage in a 40-foot cone (DC 23 basic Reflex save). Creatures that critically fail their save catch fire, taking 1d6 persistent fire damage. The area then fills with black smoke for 1 minute. This has the effects of mist, except it fills the cone’s area. The Eye can’t use Pyre Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

mid.name: Stoke the Flames
entries: The Eye intensifies nearby fires. Every foe within 60 feet that is taking persistent fire damage takes 2d6 fire damage.
